By afternoon, the trees pressed in.<pause>The path grew thin.<pause>And soon,
it disappeared into a creek.<pause>

To the little one,
the water sounded enormous.<pause>Too cold.<pause>Too fast.<pause>Too wide to cross.<pause>
But the dog lowered his nose<pause>and searched for the safest way.<pause>One careful step...<pause>then another.<pause>
On the other bank,<pause>the little one smiled.<pause>And together,<pause>they kept going.<pause>
